author: Acre89
quote:
Cuck simulator . Cuck is a disparaging slang noun and verb derived from cuckold. It refers to a man with an unfaithful partner, or—more broadly in modern slang and online politics—a weak, submissive, or contemptible man.

Definitions and Meanings• Noun (literal / romantic): A man whose wife or partner is sexually unfaithful (cuckold). It is also used in adult entertainment and consensual non-monogamy contexts.• Noun (insult): A derogatory label for a man viewed as weak, spineless, or submissive. On the internet and in political discourse, it is frequently used as an insult against men with liberal, progressive, or moderate views.• Verb: To be sexually unfaithful to a partner, or to have sexual relations with someone else's spouse or partner.Origin and Evolution• Etymology: Shortened from cuckold, which dates back to Middle English and connects to the cuckoo bird—known for laying its eggs in other birds' nests. Early uses of cuck appear in the 17th century.• Modern shift: While historically tied to marital infidelity, the term expanded in online forums and political slang to attack perceived weakness or political opponents. Opinions on Reddit differ on how the word is applied, with some viewing it primarily as a broad online insult implying weakness, while others stick closer to its literal meaning involving infidelity.
